### New or amended evidence units

#### 2B — International peace and security

- `N-2B-7`: On 8 May 2023, Jokowi publicly called for an immediate end to Myanmar violence and said Indonesia’s ASEAN chairmanship would continue pressing implementation of the Five-Point Consensus. Direct presidential statement; target-period. [Indonesian Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/serukan-penghentian-kekerasan-di-myanmar-presiden-mari-cari-solusi-bersama/).
- `N-2B-8`: On 8 August 2023, Jokowi said resolving Myanmar required political will from all sides and that ASEAN must move forward as a “big ship.” Direct presidential diplomatic posture; target-period. [The Jakarta Post](https://www.thejakartapost.com/world/2023/08/08/jokowi-says-myanmar-solution-needs-political-will-from-all-sides).
- `N-2B-9`: At the September 2023 ASEAN summit hosted by Indonesia, leaders transferred the 2026 chairmanship away from Myanmar; Jokowi called for “tactical and extraordinary” efforts. Direct chair-level regional decision, with security relevance. [Associated Press](https://apnews.com/article/3.5.2023-myanmar-wont-be-allowed-to-lead-association-of-southeast-asian-nations-in-2026-in-blow-to-generals).

Retain the contrary HRW finding that Indonesia’s February chair statement used weak language and lacked concrete enforcement, while preserving HRW’s account of Indonesia’s behind-the-scenes UN implementation plan. [HRW](https://www.hrw.org/news/2023/03/31/indonesias-asean-leadership-tested-myanmar).

#### 3B — Domestic safety and protection

- `N-3B-5`: On 20 March 2023, Jokowi chaired a Papua security meeting and directed TNI and Polri to support development and integrate central and regional programs to improve Papuan welfare. Direct presidential directive; target-period. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/presiden-minta-tni-polri-kawal-pembangunan-untuk-tingkatkan-kesejahteraan-masyarakat-papua/).
- `N-3B-6`: On 18 April 2023, Vice President Ma’ruf Amin ordered security forces to act firmly against armed groups but specifically instructed them not to disturb civilians. Attribute to the vice president, not automatically to Jokowi; retain as executive counter/context evidence. [Vice President’s Office](https://www.wapresri.go.id/prajurit-tni-gugur-di-papua-wapres-perintahkan-aparat-keamanan-bertindak-tegas-terhadap-kkb/).
- `N-3B-7`: A UN Special Procedures communication requested explanations for the 23 February killings of nine Indigenous Papuans and the 13 July deaths of three people, including investigation status, reparations, rules of engagement, and safeguards for civilians. Target-period accountability evidence; attribution is to the Indonesian government, not personally to Jokowi. [UN communication, pp. 7–8](https://spcommreports.ohchr.org/TMResultsBase/DownLoadPublicCommunicationFile?gId=28255).
- `N-3B-8`: Human Rights Monitor recorded 37 extrajudicial-killing victims in 2023, 62 civilian casualties, more than 76,000 displaced Papuans, and a September acquittal of two soldiers who admitted killing Papuans. Institutional/security-force evidence; retain as context with high attribution distance. [HRM Annual Report 2023](https://humanrightsmonitor.org/reports/hrm-annual-report-human-rights-and-conflict-in-west-papua-2023/).
- `N-3B-9` counter-claim: HRM also recorded exceptional positive accountability examples: five police officers convicted in Manokwari and two military members convicted in a July 2023 tribunal. [HRM Q3 report](https://humanrightsmonitor.org/reports/papua-monitor-quarterly-report-q3-a-time-marked-by-unlawful-killings-arbitrary-arrests-and-impunity-for-military-perpetrators/).
- `N-3B-10`: Komnas HAM described Wamena violence as having ideological, economic, political, and sociocultural causes and called for stronger Indigenous participation and inclusion in economic access. Context; no personal presidential attribution. [Komnas HAM](https://www.komnasham.go.id/index.php/news/2023/3/15/2325/cegah-konflik-berulang-komnas-ham-identifikasi-penyebab-kasus-kekerasan-di-papua.html).

#### 4B — Political freedom and institutions

- `N-4B-8`: The Constitutional Court’s own English record states that the ethics council found Anwar Usman violated impartiality, integrity, competence, independence, and propriety; removed him as chief justice; and barred him from election-dispute cases. This is a precise primary locator for the ethics aftermath, not evidence that Jokowi directed the Court. [Constitutional Court](https://en.mkri.id/news/details/2023-11-07/Ethics_Council_Removes_Anwar_Usman_from_Chief_Justice_Position).
- `N-4B-9`: The Indonesian Court record states that 21 complaints concerned Decision 90/PUU-XXI/2023 and that the ethics council found collective failures involving conflict-of-interest practices and leaked deliberations. Institutional-checks evidence. [MKRI record](https://www.mkri.id/berita/-19751).
- `N-4B-10` counter/context: On 30 December 2023 Jokowi addressed the KPU’s national consolidation meeting and called for good election governance. Treat as official self-assessment, not independent evidence of neutrality. [KPU](https://www.kpu.go.id/berita/baca/12176/presiden-jokowi-pastikan-tata-kelola-pemilu-baik).

#### 5B — Economic prosperity

- `N-5B-12`: The IMF’s June 2023 Article IV assessed Indonesia’s coordinated policies, projected roughly 2023 growth moderation, falling inflation, financial stability, and the need for continued vigilance. Institutional macro assessment; do not attribute Bank Indonesia’s independent rate decision to Jokowi. [IMF Country Report 23/221](https://www.imf.org/en/publications/cr/issues/2023/06/22/indonesia-2023-article-iv-consultation-press-release-staff-report-and-statement-by-the-535060).
- `N-5B-13`: The World Bank projected 4.9% 2023 growth and attributed easing inflation partly to improved harvests, government interventions addressing food bottlenecks, fiscal consolidation, and spending discipline. Retain as outcome/context, with limited executive attribution. [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/press-release/2023/06/26/indonesia-growth-seen-moderating-in-2023-as-pandemic-rebound-fades).
- `N-5B-14`: On 10 August 2023, Jokowi explicitly reaffirmed downstreaming, cited the June bauxite-export ban, and claimed increased nickel-export value and state revenue. Direct policy ownership; target-period. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/en/govt-reaffirms-commitment-to-downstream-industry/).
- `N-5B-15`: On 1 February 2023, Jokowi ordered banks to support and monitor downstreaming, told ministers to continue despite the WTO loss, and described the policy’s intended value-added and EV-battery ecosystem. Direct executive direction and documented contrary international legal outcome. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/en/president-jokowi-orders-banking-to-monitor-downstream-policy/).
- Replace the prior gateway-only WTO citation with the official WTO dispute record: [WTO DS592](https://www.wto.org/english/tratop_e/dispu_e/cases_e/ds592_e.htm).

#### 6B — Human development

- `N-6B-5`: BPS reported Indonesia’s 2023 HDI at 74.39, up from 73.77, with improvements in longevity, schooling, and living standards. Country outcome; retain as context unless linked to a specific executive intervention. [BPS](https://www.bps.go.id/en/pressrelease/2023/11/15/2033/indonesia-s-human).
- `N-6B-6`: Indonesia’s 2023 Health Survey reported national child stunting prevalence of 21.5%. Country outcome; retain as context and contrary to any claim of complete welfare success. [Ministry of Health](https://www.badankebijakan.kemkes.go.id/daftar-frequently-asked-question-seputar-hasil-utama-ski-2023/hasil-utama-ski-2023/).
- `N-6B-7`: The World Bank’s 2023 Indonesia Economic Prospects report found pandemic learning losses, especially among poor households, and documented widened inequality in learning outcomes. [World Bank](https://www.worldbank.org/en/country/indonesia/publication/indonesia-economic-prospects-iep-june-2023-the-invisible-toll-of-covid-19-on-learning).
- `N-6B-8` counter-claim: BRIN published its 2023 science, research, and innovation indicators report, presenting national research and innovation data and achievements. This weakens the undifferentiated claim that BRIN produced “not even one significant” result; retain as institutional counter/context, not proof of presidential effectiveness. [BRIN](https://penerbit.brin.go.id/others/catalog/book/939).

#### 7B — Personal integrity

- `N-7B-5`: On 27 November 2023, Jokowi appointed Nawawi Pomolango interim KPK chair under Presidential Decree 116/P/2023 after Firli’s temporary dismissal. Direct corrective action and precise legal locator. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/en/nawawi-pomolango-appointed-as-interim-chairperson-of-kpk/).
- `N-7B-6`: In his 12 December 2023 anti-corruption speech, Jokowi acknowledged the scale of corruption convictions and said the system required a “total evaluation,” including procurement, licensing, internal oversight, prevention, and enforcement. Direct statement; retain as evidence of stated recognition/correction, with self-assessment caveat. [State Secretariat](https://www.setneg.go.id/baca/index/sambutan_presiden_joko_widodo_pada_puncak_peringatan_hari_antikorupsi_sedunia_tahun_2023).
- `N-7B-7` counter/context: On 25 August 2023 Jokowi said the KPK’s system was good and that it regularly conducted arrests. This is a presidential defense of the institution, not independent proof of integrity, but it is contrary evidence to an interpretation of open presidential abandonment. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/soal-isu-pembubaran-kpk-presiden-perlu-ada-evaluasi/).
- The targeted search for a 2023 Jokowi asset-disclosure or personal-enrichment event did not recover a defensible unit. Keep that gap open; do not infer enrichment from cabinet or ministerial corruption.

#### 8B — Effectiveness and competence

- `N-8B-9`: Jokowi formally inaugurated Whoosh on 2 October 2023; the official record gives the 142.3-km route, four stations, and 350-km/h speed. Direct delivery outcome. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/presiden-resmikan-operasional-kereta-cepat-jakarta-bandung-whoosh/).
- `N-8B-10`: In the inauguration press statement, Jokowi said the service’s purpose was public transport rather than profit, acknowledged the fare and state-subsidy context, and said further integration studies were continuing. This is direct program framing plus an explicit absence of completed evaluation at launch. [Presidential press statement](https://setkab.go.id/en/press-statement-of-president-of-the-republic-of-indonesia-after-the-inauguration-of-the-jakarta-bandung-fast-train-kcjb-whoosh-october-2-2023/).
- `N-8B-11`: In March 2023, officials reported IKN physical construction at 26% after a presidentially chaired meeting. Direct implementation metric, though reported by the ministry rather than independently audited. [Ministry of Administrative Reform](https://www.menpan.go.id/site/berita-terkini/berita-daerah/progres-pembangunan-fisik-ikn-capai-26-persen).
- `N-8B-12`: On 21 September 2023, Jokowi described IKN as an effort to rebalance Java-centered growth, cited water infrastructure, and set a target for the Balikpapan–IKN toll road. Direct program goals and implementation milestones. [Cabinet Secretariat](https://setkab.go.id/en/ikn-development-to-evenly-distribute-economy-in-indonesia-president-jokowi-says/).
- `N-8B-13` counter/context: BRIN’s 2023 indicator publication demonstrates that the agency produced a formal national research-and-innovation report, although it does not establish strong research performance or resolve the broader BRIN criticism. [BRIN](https://penerbit.brin.go.id/others/catalog/book/939).
- Preserve the AP contrary evidence that Whoosh opened after delays and substantial cost growth: [AP News](https://apnews.com/article/3f1e4b5be6a83a0b0f54981c2e93be60).
